confidence: Low to moderate on poisoning route, low on culprit. Cyanide is isolated to donor glass, but placement window and manager custody both remain viable.
plausibility_notes: Negative shared-punch and food tests make selective glass contamination the natural inference.
The unattended glass during a salon argument creates a believable opportunity without requiring a poisoned punch bowl.
Service manager statement cannot independently establish uninterrupted innocent custody; photographer images may help later.
The new wrapped glass makes earlier contamination less likely, but the supplied captions do not prove its interior was clean.
A manager having to negotiate disputed payment during an active gala is plausible, and useful to the mystery.
